 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Extract each non-background color as a shape, ordered by its original
    # leftmost column; preserve its internal geometry.
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0},
                    key=lambda c: min(j for row in grid for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == c))
    shapes = {}
    for c in colors:
        cells = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == c]
        r0, c0 = min(i for i, j in cells), min(j for i, j in cells)
        shapes[c] = [(i-r0, j-c0) for i, j in cells]
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    r, col = 0, 0
    for color in colors:
        shape = shapes[color]
        for dr, dc in shape:
            rr, cc = r+dr, col+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
        r += max(dr for dr, dc in shape)
        col += max(dc for dr, dc in shape)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo_in = [[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
    for i in range(7,10):
        for j in range(2): demo_in[i][j]=1
